detection_coco128.note: COCO128 = first 128 COCO train2017 images (Ultralytics mirror); small-sample estimate, not full COCO val2017.

enhancement_synthetic_lowlight.note: Degradation is synthetic (gamma 2.2 + Gaussian noise sigma 12) and labelled as such; enhancement recovery is measured against the clean originals.

tracking_vtest.video: vtest.avi (OpenCV sample surveillance video, elevated camera)
tracking_vtest.note: No identity ground truth for vtest.avi; MOTA/IDF1 are NOT claimed. Unique-track count includes fragmentation from occlusions — reported as observed.

enhancement_real_lolv2.dataset: LOLv2-Real test split (real paired photographs, exposure-varied capture)
enhancement_real_lolv2.note: Both the low-light inputs and the normal-light references are real photographs; nothing in this evaluation is synthetic.

detection_exdark_lowlight.dataset: ExDark test split (734 real low-light images, human annotations; labels remapped ExDark->COCO)
detection_exdark_lowlight.enhancement_variant: enhance_frame_fast (CLAHE + unsharp, no NLM) for the enhanced copy
